title: My Light Breaks Out Like Morning
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I have a little loaf of bread
And two warm hands to share;
I'll break it for a hungry friend
And show him that I care.

[Chorus]
My light breaks out like morning sun,
It glows like bright noonday;
When I give what I have away,
My heart turns bright today.

[Verse 2]
I'll open wide our cozy door
For friends out in the cold;
I'll wrap them in my warmest coat
And hug them, young and old.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Two clementines were in my lunch,
My friend beside had none;
I rolled one gently to her side,
And now we both have one.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Like gardens with the water near,
Like springs that never dry,
Heavenly Father fills my heart
And lifts my light up high.

[Chorus]
mood: Opening-hands music. A bright, easy walking pulse under the voice, like a child carrying warm bread across a sunny kitchen to someone who needs it. A small string quartet plucks the step and then draws long, warm notes as the chorus opens, like light coming over a hill. Glad rather than grand, each verse a little warmer, the last chorus resting on one bright held chord.
